integrity: The exact polynomial follows from a proof of deletion witnesses and a complete nonnegative three-gap classification; independent generic-automaton computations are corroboration only. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary words with exactly two 1s; no claim for higher weight, larger alphabets, or an extension of previously known wordwise algorithms. The limiting law uses uniform fixed-weight words. Unindexed prior enumeration remains possible.
title: Exact bounded-height enumerator and broken-stick law for two-marker binary words
